Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! Mohammad Naim and Soumya Sarkar are at the crease to open the innings for Bangladesh. Mitchell Starc to start with the ball for Australia.

Right then! The bowlers have done their part and it is upon their batters now to chase this modest total. Bangladesh would fancy their chances here. Let's see if Australia can pull a rabbit out of their hat. Join us for the run chase in a while.

Bangladesh were excellent with the ball! Mahedi Hasan got the wicket of Alex Carey early into the innings. Mustafizur Rahman showed his brilliance and outfoxed Josh Phillippe with a cunning slower ball. The bowlers didn't allow the batters to get momentum and made sure the batters worked hard to get boundaries. Runs only kept coming in singles for them. While Shakib Al Hasan got the better of Henriques, Shoriful Islam picked up a crucial wicket of the dangerous Marsh at an important time. After that, it was easy for the bowlers to maintain the momentum and they restricted Australia for a below-par score of 121. Mustafizur Rahman was the pick of the lot as he snared 3 wickets in his four overs.

Australia were rusty with the bat! Alex Carey and Josh Philippe looked confident at the start but the former was trying too many things and paid the price as he got out. Philippe's iffy knock also came to end soon after that. Moises Henriques and Mitchell Marsh kept the scoreboard ticking and didn't play any risky shots. The duo motored the innings but the boundaries just weren't coming for them. Australia didn't cross the 100 run mark till the 17th over. It was Marsh who once again showed his caliber and scored a crucial 45. But he got out at the wrong time and Australia found themselves in a tough spot. In the end, they only managed to put 121 on the board.
Full ball, on off. Mitchell Starc heaves it towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Handy runs these from Mitchell Starc in the end. Australia finish with 121-7.
Slower ball, way outside off. Mitchell Starc reaches out to this wide ball and outside edges it towards third man for a couple of runs.
Slower and short ball, outside off. Mitchell Starc looks to slog but misses.
FOUR! A welcome boundary this for Australia. Full ball, on middle. Mitchell Starc whips it towards square leg for a boundary.
LEG BYE! Back of a length ball, strayed on the pads. Andrew Tye looks to heave it on the leg side but gets hit on the pads and they take one as the ball rolls away towards point.
Slower ball, on off. Andrew Tye lofts it towards long off for a couple of runs.
On a length on off, Tye taps it to point for a run.
Length ball on off, Starc works it towards point for one.
Length ball outside off, Starc moves across and tries to heave it on the leg side. He miscues and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full ball, on off. Driven back past the bowler for a couple of runs.
Andrew Tye walks out to bat at No.9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Slower ball, outside off. Ashton Turner looks to loft it over cover but gets deceived with the change of pace. He hits it straight to Mahmudullah at cover. Shoriful Islam gets his second wicket.
Slower ball, outside off. Mitchell Starc pushes it towards sweeper cover for one.
Good length ball, around off. Mitchell Starc taps it to point and takes a quick run.
Slower ball, on off. Mitchell Starc turns it on the leg side uppishly.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side. Mitchell Starc misses the flick and it is called wide.
Mitchell Starc is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An off-cutter outside off from Mustafizur Rahman. Ashton Agar looks to defend but there is some extra bounce and the ball takes the outside edge towards the keeper. Nurul Hasan takes an easy catch. Two in two for Mustafizur Rahman. Can we see a hat-trick?
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Ashton Agar walks out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Full ball, around leg. Matthew Wade shuffles across and tries to sweep it behind square but misses it and the ball crashes onto his leg stump. Another one bites the dust for Australia. Bangladesh are on top.
Back of a length ball, on off. Worked towards sweeper cover for a run.
Slower ball, outside off. Ashton Turner makes room on the off side but leaves it alone as it was out of his reach.
Slower ball, on off. Ashton Turner pushes it towards cover for a run.
Good length ball, on off. Ashton Turner blocks it as he had no pace to work with.
Good length ball, around middle. Ashton Turner defends it watchfully back to the bowler.
Short of a length ball, around leg. Matthew Wade heaves it towards mid-wicket for one.

Slower ball, around off. Ashton Turner taps it to point and looks to take a quick single. The fielder at point collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. Matthew Wade was outside his crease and he would have gone had that hit the stumps.
Ashton Turner is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Huge wicket this in the context of this game! Good length ball, around off. Mitchell Marsh slogs hard but gets a thick outside edge and the keeper. Nurul Hasan behind the sticks does the rest. Australia in deep trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide. Punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Matthew Wade cuts it late towards backward point for a quick run.
Short ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on off. Matthew Wade works it down to long off for one.
Quicker ball, on off. Pushed off the back foot towards cover for one.

FOUR! Tossed up, strayed on the pads. Mitchell Marsh whips it off his pads towards square leg for a boundary. The fielder makes a valiant attempt to stop the ball but the ball wins the race to the boundary.
Mahedi Hasan is back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-3-1.
Flighted ball, around middle and leg. Mitchell Marsh flicks it on the on side for a quick single.
Quicker ball, on off. Matthew Wade taps it towards point and takes a quick run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Matthew Wade looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter and quicker on off, Wade tries to cut but misses. Nurul Hasan whips the bails off in a flash but Wade is well in.
Matthew Wade walks out to bat at No.5.

OUT! Cleaned him up! Moises Henriques gets down on one knee to slog sweep this flatter ball, around off but misses it completely and the ball crashes onto his off stump. Big wicket this for Bangladesh as the set batter departs.
Tossed up, on off. Flicked towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Connects it well this time! Length ball on middle, Moises Henriques thumps it towards deep square leg and fetches himself a boundary.
Short ball on middle, surprises the batsman. Henriques tries to pull but fails to get any bat to it.
Length ball on off, Henriques hangs back and punches it off the back foot through covers. Two taken.
FOUR! Put away! Back of a length on leg, Moises Henriques gets into the position early and pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Henriques looks to cut it away but fails to connect.
Oh, very close! Good length ball on middle, Moises Henriques charges down the track and tries to slash it away. He misses and the ball goes past his bat just over the stumps, to the keeper.
Who will come to bowl now? Shoriful Islam it is.
Tossed up nicely outside off. Moises Henriques tries to drive it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to third man for a single.
On middle, Marsh knocks it to long off for a run.
Floated it up on off, Marsh drives it through covers to collect a couple of runs.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Pressure release shot! Loopy ball on middle, Moises Henriques advances down the track. He smacks it straight over the bowler's head. Valiant effort in the deep but in vain. A boundary.
Flatter ball on leg, Marsh tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Who will bowl now? Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack.
Much fuller this time, outside off. Marsh steers it towards deep cover. He retains the strike taking a single.
On a length on leg, Henriques glances it around the corner for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Marsh nudges it to the mid on region for one.
Slower delivery again on off, Henriques taps it towards point. He scampers across for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but the throw is too wild.
Length ball on middle, Marsh bunts it down to long on. He rotates the strike.
An off-cutter on off, Marsh has no clue of that. He looks to push it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back into the attack.
Quicker delivery on middle, Henriques knocks it back to the bowler.
On off, Marsh drives it to long off for a single.
Slower through the air on off, Henriques shimmies down and chips it to mid off for a single.
Flatter ball on off, turning away. Henriques looks to defend but gets an outside edge. The ball rolls on the off side.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Tossed up delivery on middle, Moises Henriques uses his feet and smacks it straight over the bowler's head for the first six of the Australia innings.
Flatter and quicker delivery on middle, Marsh makes room for himself and guides it to third man for a run.
Good length ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh punches it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Length ball, on off. Mitchell Marsh defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Australia! Back of a length ball, on off. Mitchell Marsh heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, around off. Mitchell Marsh drives it hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Good length ball, angling in slightly. Flicked towards square leg for one.
Good length ball, on off. Pushed towards long on for one off the back foot.
Soumya Sarkar is introduced into the attack.
Quicker ball, on off. Moises Henriques pushes it off the back foot, back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, around middle. Mitchell Marsh pushes it towards long on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Mitchell Marsh looks to drive on the up but gets a thick outside edge towards point.
Flighted ball, on off. Driven towards long off for a run.
Flighted ball, around off. Moises Henriques defends it watchfully.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed towards sweeper cover for one.
Nasum Ahmed is back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-17-0.
Good length ball, around middle. Mitchell Marsh works it on the on side behind square for a run.
Length ball, around leg. Mitchell Marsh tickles it fine towards fine leg for a brace.
Slower ball, around leg. Mitchell Marsh looks to heave it on the side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Bangladesh appeal for an LBW but the umpire turns it down.
Back of a length ball, around leg. Flicked towards square leg for one.
Good length ball, around off. Worked towards point for a run.
FOUR! WOW! Full ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh lofts it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Shakib Al Hasan darts it on the pads, Marsh glances it to square leg for a single.
On off, pushed towards covers.
Flatter ball on off, Marsh works it off the inside edge to mid-wicket.
This is eased down to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Henriques prods and blocks it out.
Short and outside off, Henriques defends it out.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
Slower ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh pushes it uppishly towards cover. Australia are 32/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Good length ball, around middle. Worked towards mid-wicket for a run. Moises Henriques is off the mark.
Moises Henriques is the new batsman in.

OUT! Cleaned him up! It was an off-cutter from Mustafizur Rahman around leg. Josh Philippe was in two minds whether to leave it or work it towards the on side as he shuffled across. He misses the ball and it crashes onto the stumps.
A leg-cutter around leg. Josh Philippe defends it out.
Slower ball, around middle. Josh Philippe defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Low full toss, outside off. Josh Philippe drives it back past the bowler for a boundary.
Very full and on off, Philippe drills it to long on for a single.
Flatter and on middle, Philippe blocks it out.
Flatter ball, around off. Josh Philippe defends it towards cover.
Full and on off, Marsh pushes it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on middle, Mitchell Marsh gets under it and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Short and on middle, Phillipe looks to pull it on the leg side but misses it completely. He gets hit on the thigh pad. Nasun Ahmed pleads the umpire for an lBW but nothing from the umpire. Bangladesh opts for a review. Ultra Edge shows that there is a spike as the ball passes the bat. Bangladesh lose a review. Phillippe gets a single.
Bangladesh have taken a review for LBW. Ultra Edge shows that there is a spike as the ball passes the bat. Inside edge saves Josh Philippe here. Bangladesh lose their review.
Nasum Ahmed comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and outside off, Mitchell Marsh rocks back, opens the face of the bat and creams it through covers for a boundary.

On the pads, Marsh nudges it to mid on for a run.
Floated it up on off, Marsh pushes it to cover.
Slower and outside off, Marsh blocks it out.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack.
Almost dragged on! Flatter and quicker on off, Josh Philippe looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes through his back pad, past the stumps, towards fine leg. A single taken.
Tossed up, around off. Mitchell Marsh defends it towards cover. Brilliant over this from Mahedi Hasan.
Flatter ball, around off. Mitchell Marsh defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, on off. Mitchell Marsh blocks it watchfully.
Who will come out to bat next? Mitchell Marsh comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! You can't keep Mahedi Hasan out of the game for too long! Flatter ball, full and on off, Alex Carey gets on one knee and tries to slog sweep it. He miscues his shot. The ball goes off the inner half of his willow and straight to the man at mid on. Nasum Ahmed gets under it and gulps it down. Mahedi Hasan draws the first blood and Alex Carey has to take the long route to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Nasum Ahmed b Mahedi Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller on off, Carey leans and defensively pushes it towards covers.
Flatter ball on off, Carey pushes it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Push and run! Loopy ball on off, Carey drives it towards covers for a run. 10 runs from the over.
Full and on middle, Carey sweeps it on the leg side.
FOUR! Reverse sweep again, boundary again! Tossed up wide outside off, Alex Carey reverse sweeps it past point this time to get a boundary.
On middle, Carey sweeps it to square leg.
FOUR! Innovative shot! A juicy full toss on off, Alex Carey reverse sweeps it to perfection to third man for a boundary. He is showing some intent straightaway.
Ahmed starts with a short ball on off, Phillipe plays it towards mid on. He crosses ends.
Who will bowl from the other end? Nasum Ahmed it is.
Tossed up on middle, Carey is solid in his defense. A good start from Bangladesh. Just the single from the over.
Full and on middle, Carey tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on off, Carey puts a stride forward and looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to point.
Full toss on middle, Josh Philippe knocks it in front of the long on fielder. Australia and Phillipe are off underway with a single.
Loopy ball on off, Phillipe pushes it towards covers.
Mahedi Hasan starts with a tossed up ball on middle, Josh Philippe drives it back to the bowler.

We are ready for the action to begin! The Bangladesh players form a huddle and now stride out to the middle. Alex Carey and Josh Phillipe will open the batting for Australia. Mahedi Hasan to begin with the ball. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Farveez Maharoof says that the pitch is pretty hard. Adds that the batters will enjoy the new ball. Mentions that the batsmen will struggle later on as the ball will get old. Says that there is hardly any grass on the pitch. States that 140 will be a good score on this pitch.

Bangladesh (Unchanged XI) - Mohammad Naim, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Nurul Hasan (WK), Afif Hossain, Shamim Hossain, Mahedi Hasan, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam, Nasum Ahmed.
Australia (Unchanged XI) - Alex Carey, Josh Philippe, Mitchell Marsh, Moises Henriques, Matthew Wade (C/WK), Ashton Turner, Mitchell Starc, Andrew Tye, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - The news from the middle is that Australia have won the toss and they will BAT first.

It is raining T20Is! With so much T20 action already happening around the globe, the recent is that Bangladesh will welcome New Zealand for 5 T20Is in the next month in the build-up of both the team's preparations for the 2021 T20 World Cup.

For the unversed, Bangladesh were scheduled to host ODI and T20I series against England in September-October. However, the tour has been postponed which means that the English players are available for participation in the Indian T20 League which will commence on September 19. Great news for cricket fans worldwide.

The first Test between England and India is underway. England have won the toss and have elected to bat first. By the time we bring you the updates of this match, you can switch tabs to enjoy the action of that match.

Australia have lost 5 of their last 6 T20I matches and the template of their loss remains the same - surrendering to spinners. They need to work on their game against spin. It will be interesting to see how they face the spinners of the Bangladesh team today. It will be also interesting to see whether depleted Australia will make any changes to the side after suffering a defeat in the first T20I.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between Bangladesh and Australia. The hosts stunned the Aussies in the first T20I and will look to extend their lead. The momentum is clearly on their side and Bangladesh would not want that to slip away. Meanwhile, the Kangaroos need to regroup quickly. They would be keen to right their wrongs and will look to get back to winning ways. Will the Tigers extend their lead? Or will the visitors bounce back? Let's find out.
